### 
Aadhaar Lock/Unlock
![expand](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/AccordionArrow.svg)
What is Aadhaar (UID) Lock & Unlock?
For an Aadhaar number holder, security and privacy of personal data is always a primary concern. To strengthen the security of his/her Aadhaar number and to provide control to the Aadhaar number holder, UIDAI provide a mechanism of locking and unlocking Aadhaar number (UID).
Aadhaar number holder can lock his or her Aadhaar (UID) via UIDAI website ([www.myaadhaar.uidai.gov
